title: Dormant Watcher / Still Figure in Deep Background

source_refs.author: Comparative staging practice
source_refs.title: Background figure held in depth
source_refs.cultural_context: Stage and cinema blocking in which a living figure is parked in depth and not yet used

observed_structure: Foreground behavior is readable and occupies the near plane.
A second figure stands far back, alive enough to act, and does not move.
The shot ends with that figure still unaddressed, so attention has a debt.
dramatic_operations: hold an inert figure motionless in deep background
let foreground behavior proceed without addressing the watcher
keep unresolved attention on the unmoving body
cinematic_affordances: wide depth with the figure small at the far end of an aisle
no eyeline from the foreground actor toward the watcher
the figure excluded from speech and from the main action path
a later cut that still finds the figure unmoved
cultural_scope: general depth staging; do not assign a spirit or surveillance ideology without project evidence
misuse_risks: a extra parked in the background with no later pressure
creeping the figure forward before the scene has earned a change
explaining the watcher in dialogue at the moment of introduction

variables: how long the figure is withheld from action

transferable_structure: a figure that could act is held motionless in deep background and foreground behavior proceeds without addressing that figure
non_transferable_surface: a copied lurking silhouette, specific costume, or shot that recreates one film's background threat
